label: List runs
description: List this project's runs, newest first, narrowed by instance, status, the node that started them, a tag, or age, with how many match in all (`total`). At most `limit` come back; when `total` is larger, narrow the filters to reach the older ones. To only know how many, use `CountRuns`.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Only the runs for this instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Only the runs that ended this way (`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`), `running` for the ones still going (a run parked on a wait included), or `waiting_for_input` for only the ones parked on a wait. Any other word is refused.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: Only the runs this node started (the trigger that fired, or the node a run was started from), named the way the program writes it.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.description: Only the runs carrying this tag, given the way `TagRun` was given it: the same value finds the same runs.

inputs.name: olderThanSecs
inputs.description: Only the runs started at least this many seconds ago, a whole number.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: How many runs to list at most, from 1 to 200.

outputs.name: runs
outputs.description: One entry per run, newest first: `{ execution_id, project_id, entry_node, status, phase, started_at, completed_at, tags, cancel_cause, error?, skipped_nodes, instance? }`. `status` is `running`, `waiting_for_input` (parked on a wait), `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`; a `failed` run carries `error`, what failed it; times are unix seconds.

outputs.name: total
outputs.description: How many runs match the filters, however many were listed.

then.message: ListRuns '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no node of this program. Name it the way the program writes it (`inbox`, or `one.inbox` inside an included file).
